description.short: Blue Ocean Activities is a Cardiff-based outdoor adventure company offering guided canyoning, gorge walking, coasteering, caving, abseiling, and white water rafting across South Wales and the Brecon Beacons National Park. With AALA-licensed instructors and over a decade of experience, they cater to groups of all abilities including stag and hen parties, corporate teams, families, and youth groups.
description.shortNote: Drafted from verified website content and cross-referenced against TripAdvisor, Visit Mid Wales, and Yumping. Needs editorial review before publishing. Do not use the phrase 'since 2008' without direct confirmation from the operator.
description.full:
Blue Ocean Activities is a South Wales adventure company based in Cardiff, offering a wide range of outdoor pursuits for groups, families, corporate teams, and special occasion parties including stag and hen weekends. Operating across the Brecon Beacons National Park, the Gower Peninsula, and the Pembrokeshire coast, all activities are led by qualified instructors with extensive experience in their disciplines.

Their flagship activity is canyoning in the Brecon Beacons — walking, climbing, jumping, abseiling, and swimming through gorges and waterfalls in one of the UK's premier adventure landscapes. Gorge walking and gorge scrambling take place at Dinas Rock, while caving sessions are held at Porth Yr Ogof, one of the most popular cave systems in the National Park. Coasteering sessions run along the South Wales coast including the Gower Peninsula, Tenby, and St Davids in Pembrokeshire. Additional activities include rock climbing on crags in the Brecon Beacons and Morlais Quarries in Merthyr Tydfil, abseiling, white water rafting on a former British Championships course (approximately 10km, 2.5 hours), surf kayaking, bodyboarding, survival skills and wild camping, corporate team events, and health and wellness days.

Blue Ocean Activities holds an Adventure Activities Licensing Authority (AALA) licence, which permits them to run regulated activities for young people under 18. They are affiliated with Visit Wales, Day Out With The Kids (DOWTK), Great Days Out UK, and the South Wales Outdoor Activity Providers Group. All equipment — including wetsuits, helmets, and buoyancy aids — is provided for relevant activities.

On TripAdvisor, Blue Ocean Activities is rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 700 reviews, ranked #3 of 62 Outdoor Activities in Cardiff, and has won the TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Award for eight consecutive years, including 2026.
